name: seo-rea
description: Evidence-first SEO and AI-search teardown CLI and MCP server: reverse engineer why pages rank, free sources first.
author: DevgenX

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.dossier-schema: npm run build && node -e "import('./dist/core/dossier.js').then((m) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(m.dossierJsonSchema(), null, 2) + '\n'))" > docs/dossier-schema.json
scripts.strategy-schema: npm run build && node -e "import('./dist/core/strategy/schema.js').then((m) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(m.strategyJsonSchema(), null, 2) + '\n'))" > docs/strategy-schema.json
scripts.error-schema: npm run build && node -e "import('./dist/core/errors.js').then((m) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(m.errorContractJsonSchema(), null, 2) + '\\n'))" > docs/error-contract.schema.json
scripts.crawl-schema: npm run build && node -e "import('./dist/core/crawl/schema.js').then((m) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(m.crawlJsonSchema(), null, 2) + '\\n'))" > docs/crawl-schema.json
scripts.diff-schema: npm run build && node -e "import('./dist/core/diff/schema.js').then((m) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(m.diffJsonSchema(), null, 2) + '\\n'))" > docs/diff-schema.json
